svg.title: Dataset generator: independent recipe-only generation
svg.desc: Eight stages: source catalogue, family preparation, controlled recipes, independent client training and evaluation, metadata and QoS, provenance and reconstruction, benchmark database, and downstream tasks. A separate audit-data route bypasses catalogue selection.
svg.text: DATASET GENERATOR
Framework for independent service generation
NEW MODE / INDEPENDENT + RECIPE-ONLY
One shared initial state. Many controlled service variants.
Source model / dataset catalogue
Select compatible model-dataset-task contracts
MODEL SOURCES
Hugging Face models and local neural baselines
Architecture, task head and parameter schema
DATASET SOURCES
Dataset/configuration and source revisions
Official training and separate evaluation splits
CONTRACT PREFLIGHT
Task, modality, labels and split compatibility
Record excluded or unsupported candidates
Output: compatible source contracts + preflight report
Family preparation
Pin and freeze shared dependencies
SEMANTIC FAMILY CONTRACT
Pinned sources; task, label and preprocessing rules
Shared fitted transforms and parameter contract
COMMON INITIAL STATE
Initialise the model / task head once; retain w0
Every client resets to this same frozen state
FROZEN DATA RESERVATIONS
Full training source; common catalogue subset
Separate saved audit rows for downstream checks
Output: family ID + contract + w0 + reservation
Controlled service recipes
Versioned policies with seeded coverage
CLIENT DATA VARIATION
Quantity, sampling seed and distribution intensity
IID / Dirichlet / shard on supported sampling axes
TRAINING VARIATION
Optimizer, learning rate, batch size and epochs
Accumulation, weight decay, warmup; feasibility
CATALOGUE-INFORMED POLICIES, WHERE ELIGIBLE
70% supported / 20% challenging / 10% stress
Frozen historical evidence; explicit fallback policies
Output: planned manifest + policy hashes + coverage
shared state + training source + catalogue rows
saved audit rows: reserved for downstream validation
Heterogeneous client training and evaluation
Repeat across compatible families; clients are independent experiments
SELECT RAW ROWS, THEN PREPARE
Sample without replacement within each client
Allow overlap across clients; record realised counts
Prepare selected rows; replace rejected candidates
Reuse shared preparation while preserving row order
RESET w0 + OPTIMIZER / RNG STATE FOR EACH CLIENT
Client 1
w0 + data + recipe
Client 2
w0 + data + recipe
Client N
w0 + data + recipe
Train separately; capture actual settings and updates
No client-to-client model transfer or generation aggregation
COMMON CATALOGUE EVALUATION
Evaluate every client on the same frozen subset
Task-specific quality, timing and resource measures
Trust / explanation protocols where supported
Capture completion, failures and evidence status
per-service measurements + effective execution observations
Service metadata / QoS
Extract typed observations and measurement context
FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION
Task, modality, model, data and interface schemas
Family membership and realised training distribution
QUALITY + QOS + RESOURCES
Named task metric, loss and normalised quality score
Runtime / inference timing, memory and model size
Reliability indicators and modelled resource cost
EVIDENCE SEMANTICS
Units, direction, protocol, counts, intervals and status
Provenance / reconstruction
Persist authoritative recipes after execution
PER-CLIENT RECONSTRUCTION RECIPE
Family / initial-state hashes; ordered accepted row IDs
Effective settings, seeds, updates and stopping reason
Prepared-content hashes, metrics and runtime versions
EXECUTION EVIDENCE
Requested-to-effective settings and runtime changes
Hashed append-only execution records + artifact links
Default: retain shared w0 + recipes; release client weights
Optional: retain checkpoints / validation references
Benchmark database
SQLite catalogue linked to durable artifacts
QUERYABLE RECORDS
services | service_metrics | service_artifacts
Generation, split and execution provenance
Lineage / retention records; explicit failure evidence
CONTENT-ADDRESSED ARTIFACT STORE
Family documents, common initial checkpoints
Recipes, audit reservations and evaluation evidence
Join by service / family IDs; verify references and hashes
Resume skips verified completed services
catalogue + verified artifact links
Downstream benchmark tasks
Supported workflows and proposed reuse protocols; experiments require their own evaluation
CATALOGUE ANALYSIS
Service filtering / ranking and QoS prediction
Evidence coverage, failure and diversity analysis
Use held-out families and prevent target leakage
RECONSTRUCTION BENCHMARKS
Verify dependencies; replay selected client recipes
Measure fidelity against a retained reference / twin
Report storage, replay cost and functional agreement
COMPATIBLE COLLABORATIVE COMPOSITION
Freeze requests / candidates; MAB, GA, greedy, random
Replay members; sample-weighted parameter averaging
Measure aggregate quality / latency on saved audit rows
Primary data flow
Shared dependencies / reserved audit data
Recipe bands describe planned conditions; observed quality can be weak.
Logical framework: hf-manifest plans contracts and recipes; run-manifest freezes durable families and executes clients. Replay fidelity is evaluated separately.
